title: Kylo's Hunt
description: After forcing Phasma to lower Starkiller Base's shields and placing thermal detonators in strategic locations, Han Solo encountered his son, Kylo Ren. Solo confronted him about following in his grandfather's footsteps to the dark side. Ren was not interested in his father's words, he had one goal, to track Force-sensitive Rey. Soon thereafter, Lightsaber poised for battle, Ren faced young Rey in the snowy wastes outside the base. With Rey armed with Luke Skywalker's Lightsaber, the two fought a significant duel.
